messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started -> prod: model-release 'model-eos' artifact model-eos:v2.3 weights s3://artifacts/weights/model-eos-20260301.tar.gz

maria_sre: spotting a spike in perplexity on canary-2, tokenization OOV rate +14% in the last 5m :eyes:

raj_platform: confirmed — tokenizer vocab in the runtime != manifest vocab. artifact hash mismatch when comparing manifest -> checking publish logs now

maria_sre: customer impact: truncated/garbled responses reported by 3 accounts in last 10m. symptomatic of tokenizer mismatch. Recommend pausing rollout + revert to v2.2

olivia_oncall: pausing rollout via controller now: `redwood rollout pause release/2026-03-01-310`

deploy-bot: rollout pause accepted. Canary traffic frozen. Preparing rollback job for weightset -> target v2.2

raj_platform: publishing pipeline logs show a race in the artifact publisher: manifest updated before weight bundle finished uploading. manifest points to missing tokenizer shard leading to mismatch

maria_sre: can we flip the feature flag for the new model while rollback runs? quick command: ```
redwood feature toggle set model_eos_v2_3_enabled false --env prod
```

deploy-bot: feature toggle applied, new model routes disabled. Initiating rollback of canaries -> executing weightset revert to model-eos:v2.2

maria_sre: note — need to invalidate prefix/KV caches for canary pools only. if we flush globally some sessions will recompile and spike latency. Command to run: `POST /internal/ops/evict?scope=canary&kv=model-eos-v2.3-cache`

ops_lead_tom: do not flush global cache. mari a, coordinate with infra to target only canary nodes. tom taking ownership for rollback coordination

cs_mike: CS update out to affected customers: "We're aware of garbled outputs for some requests after a recent update. We've paused the rollout and are reverting to the previous model. We'll update within 30 minutes."

olivia_oncall: oncall handoff scheduled in 45m to tom. if rollback doesn't finish within 20m we'll escalate paging to eng-sre. tagging postmortem owner

deploy-bot: rollback to model-eos:v2.2 complete on canaries. Prod rollback at 12% (staggered). Monitoring tokenization OOV rate and response truncation metrics

maria_sre: OOV and truncation metrics returning to baseline on canaries. prod staging nodes following. no new error spikes after targeted cache invalidation

cs_mike: customers acknowledged improvements, will keep them updated. :thumbsup:

olivia_oncall: incident ticket INC-2026-031 created. next steps: 1) root cause (publish pipeline race), 2) add pre-deploy checksum gate for tokenizer vocab vs manifest, 3) add automated verification step to block manifest promotion until artifact upload confirmed. assigning owners in ticket

maria_sre: adding immediate mitigation checklist to runbook: - verify artifact hash matches manifest - ensure tokenizer shard presence - test micro-canary tokenization sample before >5% traffic

raj_platform: will push hotfix to publisher that retries finalization step and adds atomic manifest swap. will follow up in PR and link to INC-2026-031

olivia_oncall: thanks team — keep monitoring for 1h then start retrospective. closing pager if no regressions in 30m
